title: AI for small businesses: 27 essential tools for real business growth

facts.fact: According to the U.S. Chamber of Commerce's 2026 Empowering Small Business report, 66% of small businesses now use AI, nearly three times the share in 2023.
facts.quote: 66% of small businesses now use AI, nearly three times the share in 2023.

facts.fact: In a 2026 Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses Voices survey, only 14% of owners said AI is fully embedded in their core operations.
facts.quote: only 14% of owners said AI is fully embedded in their core operations

facts.fact: The U.S. Chamber's 2026 report found that small businesses using AI are at least 7 points more likely to report sales, profit, and workforce growth than businesses that do not use it.
facts.quote: small businesses using AI are at least 7 points more likely to report sales, profit, and workforce growth than businesses that do not use it

facts.fact: In Intuit QuickBooks' 2026 AI Impact Report (a vendor survey), 78% of U.S. businesses surveyed said AI has improved their productivity, up from 46% in July 2024.
facts.quote: 78% of U.S. businesses surveyed said AI has improved their productivity, up from 46% in July 2024.

facts.fact: The guide covers 27 AI tools for small businesses, organized by the problem each solves.
facts.quote: This guide covers 27 AI tools for small businesses
